**Daily Devotional**

**June 12**

*40 And they laughed him to scorn. But when he had put them all out, he taketh the father and the mother of the damsel, and them that were with him, and entereth in where the damsel was lying. (Mark 5:40 KJV)*

This is Mark’s account of where Jesus raised Jairus’s daughter after she had died. It is amazing that these people laughed at Jesus, the one who created them. If they had just known that their creator was the one they were laughing at, I imagine they would have acted differently. Notice again that Jesus had to put all the people out, before He could raise the daughter from death. This shows that even Jesus could not do miracles when a lot of unbelief was present (Matthew 13:57-58). He only took those with Him who had faith in His ability to raise the girl from death.

This shows again how God’s power flows through humans, and not directly from God (Ephesians 3:20). This is because God gave dominion of the earth to human beings (Genesis 1:26), and therefore to do the miracles that we humans do, the power of God has to flow through us. If we could only understand how great a power has been given to all born again Christians who have the Holy Ghost, we would be able to exercise that power, and do the healing miracles that Jesus did, and told us to do (John 14:12). Study God’s Word, and learn what you have in your born again spirit, and how to draw it out, and use it to the Glory of God. Praise God for sharing such power with His children.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
